notes.title: Early Access V0.3a
notes.content:
[h1][b]Early Access V0.3a Change Log[/b][/h1]

- Added cat food to the market.
- You can buy food from the market and feed the cat.
- Take cat food and put it in the cat bowl at home, and the cat will eat when it is hungry.
- Fixed some issues.

Updates will keep coming.

notes.title: Early Access V0.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Early Access V0.3 Change Log[/b][/h1]

- Added house.
- Added cat in house.
- You can sleep using the bed at home.
- Added crouch.
- Added eating and drinking animation for customers.
- Fixed some issues.

Updates will keep coming.

notes.title: TO BE ADDED
notes.content:
[h1][b]TO BE ADDED[/b][/h1] 

- You will be able to enter the tender and buy the businesses of the park and some regions with the auction. 
- You will be able to hire artificial intelligence workers. 
- You will be able to sell bagels by walking around the street. 
- You will be able to buy a counter to sell dumplings. 
- You will be able to get the hot dog counter. 
- You will be able to take orders. In this way, you will take orders to the houses in the city. 
- You will choose the dishes that the customer can order.
- New Tutorial system.
